experimental_method: Static vapour pressure of NaCl-KCl-MgCl2-CaCl2 solutions (with excess solid if saturated) at 25 C measured with a quartz Bourdon precision pressure gauge after freezing and pumping off air.
uncertainties_stated: Reproducibility +-0.04 kPa; temperature controlled to +-0.2 K; measured pure-water p0 = 3.146 +- 0.030 kPa (literature 3.168).
quality_remarks: Fig. 1 (vapour pressure of ternary MgCl2 solutions saturated with halite or sylvite) holds measured points only in a graph, not in a table. Observed values deviate from the authors' model by up to 0.12 kPa (rows with carnallite).
needs_pass2_reason: Text layer was clean and every cell matched the page image (only the decimal '1.34' appears as 'I .34' in the text layer, read correctly).
not_extracted_tables: Table 1: model parameters for activity and osmotic coefficients.
Table 2: molalities at singular points in ternary systems (literature solubilities) and derived interaction parameters; derived/literature, not measured here.
Table 4: parameters of the solubility surface fit.
Fig. 1: measured vapour pressures of MgCl2 solutions saturated with halite or sylvite are given only as a graph.
extraction_notes: Sanity: all observed p between 1.28 and 2.40 kPa, below p0 (3.168 kPa); p decreases with total molality roughly. No replicates. Calcd column kept in the CSV, not mapped.
